absorption: Upstream passes the URL object directly or otherwise renders it with credentials intact before creating the async engine.

consumers.name: Test suites using non-empty PostgreSQL passwords.

contract: The async test database helper preserves the real password when rendering SQLAlchemy URL objects instead of passing a redacted `***` password string to the engine.

fork: python -c 'from sqlalchemy.engine import make_url; u=make_url("postgresql+asyncpg://u:secret@localhost/db"); assert "***" in str(u); assert "secret" in u.render_as_string(hide_password=False); print("url-fidelity-ok")'`.
proof.fork_expected: the helper passes a rendered connection string containing the actual encoded credential to `create_async_engine`.
upstream: inspect `setup_test_database` on the recorded upstream base.
proof.upstream_expected: the helper converts the URL through the password-redacting `str()` representation.

upstream_gap: The recorded upstream base uses `str(db_url)`, whose SQLAlchemy string representation hides passwords and can make non-empty-password test database connections invalid.
